title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
slides: What if someone picks up your unlocked phone?
ChatGPT added a Locked Chats feature this week
But locked chats vanish from your history entirely
You must re-find them through a hidden gesture
Decide now: which conversations need that lock?
thread_text:
1. The Locked Chats Twist

ChatGPT now hides locked conversations from your history entirely. You must use a hidden gesture to find them again.

2. Vanish From History

Locked chats don't appear in your sidebar or search. They're completely invisible until you perform a secret swipe or tap.

3. Hidden Gesture Required

To access a locked chat, you need to remember and execute a specific gesture. Forgetting it means losing the conversation forever.

4. Decide Before You Lock

Not every chat needs this level of secrecy. Locking too many makes them impossible to manage.

5. Your Locking Strategy

Open ChatGPT now and list which conversations truly need the lock. If you can't remember the gesture, don't lock it.

instagram.caption:
Your locked ChatGPT conversations disappear from your history completely. 🔒

They won't show up in your sidebar or in search. When you lock a chat, it vanishes from view until you perform a hidden gesture — a secret swipe or tap — to bring it back.

Forget the gesture, and you can't reach that conversation again. Find the feature now: open ChatGPT, pick one chat you'd actually protect, and lock it before you forget how to get back in.

Which conversation of yours needs that lock? 🤔
